what: Embedding service FIXED and wired up: (1) update() in store.ts now regenerates embeddings when what/why/context_label change — same fire-and-forget pattern as add(). (2) startServer() in server.ts now creates EmbeddingService, initializes in background, attaches via setEmbeddingService(). Tries @huggingface/transformers first, falls back to local Ollama. No API keys needed. Graceful degradation if neither backend available — FTS5/LIKE search unaffected.
why: Both bugs from earlier discovery now fixed. Embeddings are fully automatic: generated on add, regenerated on update, cleaned on remove, initialized on MCP server start.
